relevance_note: Case report of two LAD-I patients with homozygous ITGB2 variants: We report two cases of LAD1 with unusual presentations.
method_note: Hand extraction from reading the paper; a Python script in scratch only assembled the JSON and resolved each typed quote to the exact paper substring (thin spaces, dash variants), failing on any non-match. Labels: the paper calls the patients 'Case 1'/'case 1' and 'Case 2'/'case 2' (table titles, Fig. 2 legend); also 'the first case', 'the second case', 'patient 2'. is_proband left null for both cases: two-case report, the paper never says proband/index case. In scope also: deceased elder sister of Case 1 and deceased male sibling of Case 2 (affected relatives, not genotyped); 'ref [24] patient' (previously published patient carrying c.817G > A, Discussion). Out of scope: Case 2's healthy sister (7 years) and brother (2 years), untested and unaffected; Case 1's mother, whose leucocytes were used only as a DHR control (Fig. 2a), not genotyped; cohorts in refs [15] and [25] mentioned only as counts. CONTRADICTIONS: (1) protein change for c.817G > A is printed as 'p. Val273Met' (Case presentation) and 'p.G273R' (Discussion); protein_hgvs left null for Case 1 and ref [24] patient. (2) Case 1 variant called 'likely pathogenic' in text but 'reported being pathogenic according to HGMD-public database' in Table 1 (HGMD's call, not recorded as the authors'). (3) c.994-1G>C called 'pathogenic' (Case 2 text, ACMG) and 'likely pathogenic' (Discussion, 'Another likely pathogenic splice-site variant'); recorded 'pathogenic'. (4) Case 2 age: Background says 'eight months old female child', case section and Table 2 say two years and eight months; recorded the latter. (5) Text says immunoglobulins normal (both cases) while Table 1 IgA 1.19 and IgM 2.00 and Table 2 IgA 0.9, IgM 1.5, IgE 476 exceed the printed reference ranges; recorded the text's 'normal' as excluded abnormal immunoglobulin levels and did not derive features from table numbers. Lab values not described in words (platelets 94, CRP, Case 2 haemoglobin 5.6) were not recorded as features. Table 2 CRP row is misaligned. Text cites 'Table 2' for Case 1 DHR and 'Table 1b' for Case 2 lymphocytes (citation slips). Case 1 umbilical cord separated on day 22: the paper does not call it delayed, so the checklist item is not reported. Case 1 'ear infection' with ear discharge not mapped to otitis media (not stated). Case 2 'absence of pus formation' marked excluded because the paper reports abscess formation and pus in the lesion. Case 2 biopsy 'negative for fungal infections' is lesion-specific; checklist fungal infections left not reported. Normal whole-examination statements (Case 1 respiratory/cardiovascular/nervous systems; Case 2 chest clear) recorded as written and exclude nothing more specific. In silico NetGene2 prediction not recorded as functional evidence; flow cytometry CD11/CD18 expression recorded instead. No transcript, genomic coordinates or parental genotyping are reported.
